prompt: There is a bug report in ISSUE.md. Fix the code in this folder so the issue is resolved. Do not ask questions; make the fix.
final_response:
Implemented the fix in `cron.py`.

What it now does:
- Parses all 5 fields with `*`, single values, lists (`1,15,30`), ranges (`1-5`), and steps (`*/15`, `10-40/10`, plus `5/15`).
- Normalizes day-of-week `7` to Sunday (`0`).
- Applies the Vixie rule: when both DOM and DOW are restricted, either matching selects the day; otherwise only the restricted field applies.
- Searches minute-by-minute logic with full month/year rollover support, including Feb 29.
- Raises `ValueError` when no match exists within five years, and rejects malformed expressions.
- Drops seconds/microseconds and always returns a time strictly after `after`.

Validated against an independent brute-force reference over fixed and randomized cases, including leap years, year boundaries, DOW aliases, and invalid inputs.
